theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 35 群

items.colloc: travel for business 因公出差 | trip for business 商務旅行
items.distinct: on business 出差 | for pleasure 為了娛樂
ex: He is traveling to Tokyo for business next week.
他下週要前往東京出差。
Is this phone call for business or personal?
這通電話是公事還是私事？
The manager is away for business until Friday.
經理因公外出直到週五。

items.colloc: up for sale 出售中 | items for sale 待售商品
items.distinct: on sale 特價中 | for rent 出租
ex: This office building is currently for sale.
這棟辦公大樓目前正在出售。
Are these computer accessories for sale?
這些電腦配件有在販售嗎？
The old equipment is listed for sale online.
舊設備已在網路上架出售。

items.colloc: apply for a permit 申請許可 | obtain a permit 獲得許可
items.distinct: get a license 取得執照 | get approval 獲得批准
ex: You need to get a permit before building.
施工前你需要先取得許可證。
Did the contractor get a permit for repairs?
承包商取得維修許可了嗎？
It is difficult to get a permit quickly.
要快速取得許可證很困難。

items.colloc: get back in touch soon 儘快聯絡 | reach out to get back in touch 聯繫以恢復溝通
items.distinct: keep in touch 保持聯繫 | lose touch 失聯
ex: I will get back in touch after the meeting.
會議結束後我會再跟你聯絡。
Please get back in touch if you need help.
如果你需要協助，請再與我聯繫。
We should get back in touch with the supplier.
我們應該與供應商恢復聯繫。

items.colloc: give a hand with 協助處理 | need a hand 需要幫忙
items.distinct: lend a hand 伸出援手 | give a helping hand 施予援手
ex: Could you give a hand with this report?
你能幫我處理這份報告嗎？
He is always willing to give a hand.
他總是樂於提供協助。
Let me give a hand to finish the task.
讓我幫忙完成這項任務吧。

items.colloc: payment in advance 預付款 | notice in advance 事先通知
items.distinct: ahead of time 提前 | beforehand 事先
ex: Please give a notice in advance for absence.
請假請事先告知。
We require the deposit to be given in advance.
我們要求預付訂金。
It is better to give an answer in advance.
最好能事先給予答覆。

items.colloc: give a presentation on 關於…進行簡報 | prepare to give a presentation 準備簡報
items.distinct: make a speech 發表演說 | hold a meeting 召開會議
ex: She will give a presentation about new products.
她將針對新產品進行簡報。
We need to give a presentation to the client.
我們需要向客戶進行簡報。
He gave a presentation that impressed everyone.
他所做的簡報讓大家都印象深刻。

items.colloc: had better not do 最好不要做 | had better finish 最好完成
items.distinct: should 應該 | ought to 應當
ex: You had better submit the form by noon.
你最好在中午前遞交表格。
We had better not delay the shipment again.
我們最好不要再延遲出貨了。
He had better follow the company regulations.
他最好遵守公司規定。

items.colloc: hand in a report 繳交報告 | hand in one's notice 提出辭呈
items.distinct: turn in 繳交 | submit 提交（正式）
ex: Did you hand in your weekly report yet?
你已經繳交週報了嗎？
Please hand in all documents by Friday.
請在週五前提交所有文件。
He had to hand in his resignation today.
他今天必須提出辭呈。

items.pos: phr. 進行一輪（賽事或談判）
items.colloc: have a second round 進行第二輪 | have a round of negotiations 進行一輪談判
items.distinct: a round of drinks 一輪飲料 | a round of applause 一陣掌聲
ex: We will have a round of discussions later.
我們稍後會進行一輪討論。
The team will have a round of interviews.
團隊將會進行一輪面試。
They decided to have a round of talks.
他們決定進行一輪會談。

items.colloc: have a tendency to increase 傾向於增加 | have a tendency to overestimate 容易高估
items.distinct: be prone to 易於 | be inclined to 傾向於
ex: New staff have a tendency to make mistakes.
新進員工傾向於犯錯。
Prices have a tendency to rise in summer.
價格在夏天有上漲的趨勢。
Consumers have a tendency to choose cheaper goods.
消費者傾向於選擇較便宜的商品。

items.colloc: head up a project 負責專案 | head up the department 領導部門
items.distinct: be in charge of 負責 | run the show 主導
ex: She was asked to head up the new team.
她被要求領導這個新團隊。
He will head up the research department soon.
他很快就會負責研發部門。
Who is going to head up the marketing campaign?
誰要來負責這次的行銷活動？

items.colloc: suffer a heart attack 心臟病發作 | risk of heart attack 心臟病風險
items.distinct: stroke 中風 | cardiac arrest 心跳停止
ex: The stress of work can lead to a heart attack.
工作壓力可能會導致心臟病發作。
He suffered a mild heart attack last night.
他昨晚輕微心臟病發作。
Employees should avoid triggers for heart attacks.
員工應避免心臟病發作的誘因。

items.colloc: apply for an import license 申請進口許可 | hold an import license 持有進口執照
items.distinct: export license 出口許可證 | business license 營業執照
ex: You must obtain an import license for these goods.
你必須為這些貨物取得進口許可證。
The company lacks a valid import license.
該公司缺乏有效的進口許可證。
Processing the import license takes two weeks.
辦理進口許可證需要兩週時間。

items.colloc: be in a hurry to do 趕著做 | in a big hurry 非常匆忙
items.distinct: in a rush 趕忙 | at a glance 一眼看去
ex: I am in a hurry to catch my flight.
我趕著去搭飛機。
Don't make decisions when you are in a hurry.
不要在匆忙時做決定。
He left the office in a hurry today.
他今天匆匆忙忙地離開辦公室。

items.colloc: back in a moment 等一下回來 | start in a moment 馬上開始
items.distinct: at the moment 此刻 | for a moment 片刻
ex: The meeting will begin in a moment.
會議馬上就要開始了。
I will be with you in a moment, sir.
先生，我馬上就來協助您。
We will have the results in a moment.
我們很快就會有結果了。

items.colloc: in a pile of papers 一堆文件中 | leave in a pile 堆放在一起
items.distinct: in a stack 疊放 | in a heap 堆積
ex: There are files in a pile on my desk.
我的桌上有一堆文件。
Please do not leave inventory in a pile.
請不要將庫存隨意堆放。
I found the mail in a pile by the door.
我在門邊發現一堆郵件。

items.colloc: in flight service 機上服務 | in flight entertainment 機上娛樂
items.distinct: on board 在飛機上 | during the flight 在飛行期間
ex: The flight attendant served drinks in flight.
空服員在飛行中提供了飲料。
The in-flight entertainment system is broken.
機上娛樂系統壞掉了。
We experienced some turbulence while in flight.
我們在飛行途中遇到了亂流。

items.colloc: be in luck today 今天很走運 | if you are in luck 如果你運氣好
items.distinct: good luck 好運 | out of luck 倒楣
ex: You are in luck, we have one left.
你運氣真好，我們還剩最後一個。
We were in luck to find an open store.
我們很幸運找到一家還在營業的店。
If you are in luck, you will get the promotion.
如果你運氣好的話，就會升職。

items.pos: phr. 就位；準備就緒；適當的
items.colloc: have a system in place 建立制度 | everything in place 一切就緒
items.distinct: in position 在位置上 | out of place 不適當
ex: We have safety measures in place now.
我們現在已經採取了安全措施。
Make sure all documents are in place.
確保所有文件都準備就緒。
The new policy will be in place next month.
新政策將於下個月開始實施。
